description: Create a new R package skeleton at the specified path using usethis::create_package(). Sets up DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, and the R/ directory.

fields.description: Named list of extra DESCRIPTION fields, e.g. {Author: 'Jane Doe', Version: '0.1.0'}.

open.description: Whether to open the new package in RStudio (default false).

path.description: Absolute path where the new package directory should be created (e.g. '/home/user/mypackage').

name: create_package
